questions.question: GitHub Actions workflow nima?
questions.explanation: github/workflows/ dagi YAML'da yozilgan avtomatik jarayon; hodisalar (push, pull_request, schedule) bilan ishga tushadigan bir yoki bir nechta job'dan iborat.

questions.question: GitHub Actions'da job va step farqi.
questions.explanation: Job — bitta runner'da ketma-ket bajariladigan step'lar to'plami. Step — alohida vazifa (shell skript yoki action). Job'lar default parallel ishlaydi.

questions.question: GitHub Actions'da reusable workflow nima?
questions.explanation: workflow_call bilan boshqa repo'lardan chaqiriladigan workflow — tashkilot bo'yicha standart compliance va deploy pipeline'larini majburlash.

questions.question: GitHub Actions'da composite action nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta shell buyruq va action step'larini bitta qayta ishlatiladigan step'ga jamlovchi custom action (action.yml).

questions.question: GitHub Actions'da job'lar orasida fayllarni qanday uzatasiz?
questions.explanation: Job'lar alohida VM'larda ishlaydi, shuning uchun A job'da actions/upload-artifact bilan yuklab, B job'da actions/download-artifact bilan olinadi.

questions.question: GitHub Actions'da AWS bilan OIDC qanday sozlanadi?
questions.explanation: permissions: { id-token: write, contents: read } qo'yiladi, keyin aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4 role-to-assume bilan GitHub JWT'ni vaqtinchalik IAM credential'ga almashtiradi. IAM role trust policy'da sub (...

questions.question: GitHub Actions'da `needs` nima?
questions.explanation: Job'lar orasidagi ketma-ketlik bog'liqligi: needs: [build, test] — deploy faqat ikkalasi muvaffaqiyatli tugagach ishlaydi.

questions.question: Matrix build'da `fail-fast` nima?
questions.explanation: strategy: ostidagi sozlama. true (default) — bitta job yiqilsa qolgan matrix job'lar bekor qilinadi. false — hammasi oxirigacha ishlaydi.

questions.question: GitHub Actions environment va protection rule'lar nima?
questions.explanation: Deploy maqsadlari (masalan production): required reviewer, wait timer va branch cheklovlari bilan — deploy job'i tasdiqdan keyingina ishlaydi; environment secret'lari ham shu yerda.

questions.question: Reusable workflow'ga secret'larni qanday xavfsiz uzatasiz?
questions.explanation: Chaqiruvchi workflow'da secrets: inherit (hammasi) yoki aniq: secrets: { DB_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DB_PASS }} }. Least privilege uchun aniq uzatish afzal.

questions.question: `.gitlab-ci.yml` arxitekturasi qanday?
questions.explanation: GitLab repo va registry bilan nativ integratsiyalangan deklarativ fayl: stage'lar, job'lar, skriptlar va artifact'lar shu yerda.

questions.question: GitLab CI stage'lari nima?
questions.explanation: Ketma-ket bajariladigan bloklar (stages: [build, test, deploy]). Bir stage ichidagi job'lar parallel; keyingi stage joriy stage'dagi hamma job muvaffaqiyatli tugagach boshlanadi.

questions.question: GitLab CI `rules` nima?
questions.explanation: Job pipeline'ga qo'shiladimi — branch nomi, commit xabari, o'zgargan fayllar (changes) yoki o'zgaruvchilar asosida hal qiluvchi shartli sintaksis (only/except o'rnini bosgan).

questions.question: GitLab Runner nima?
questions.explanation: gitlab-ci.yml job'larini bajaradigan ochiq kodli ilova; Docker, Kubernetes, SSH, Shell executor'larini qo'llaydi.

questions.question: GitLab Auto DevOps nima?
questions.explanation: Tilni avtomatik aniqlab, image build qilib, security test o'tkazib, Kubernetes'ga deploy qiladigan tayyor CI/CD shablon — pipeline yozish shart emas.

questions.question: Declarative Jenkinsfile nima?
questions.explanation: Strukturali, sintaksisi tekshiriladigan format (pipeline { agent any; stages { ... } }): environment, parameters, post kabi tayyor direktivalar bilan.

questions.question: Scripted Jenkinsfile nima?
questions.explanation: Groovy asosidagi protsedural format (node { ... }): cheksiz moslashuvchanlik, lekin qo'llab-quvvatlash murakkabroq.

questions.question: Jenkins Configuration as Code (JCasC) nima?
questions.explanation: Butun Jenkins controller konfiguratsiyasini (plugin, security realm, credential, node) Git'dagi deklarativ YAML'da saqlash.

questions.question: Jenkins Kubernetes plugin nima?
questions.explanation: Controller build uchun Kubernetes'da ephemeral agent pod'larini dinamik yaratadi va job tugashi bilan o'chiradi.

questions.question: Jenkins Shared Libraries nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta Jenkinsfile'da import qilinadigan qayta ishlatiladigan Groovy kod va pipeline step'lari markaziy Git repo'si.

questions.question: Jenkins log'larida credential oqishining oldini qanday olasiz?
questions.explanation: withCredentials([string(credentialsId: '...', variable: 'API_TOKEN')]) { ... } — qiymat konsol log'ida avtomatik mask qilinadi. Groovy string interpolatsiyasi ("${API_TOKEN}") o'rniga shell'ga single quote bilan bering.

questions.question: Jenkins Multibranch Pipeline nima?
questions.explanation: Git repo'ni skanerlab, Jenkinsfile bor har branch uchun pipeline job yaratadi va merge bo'lgan branch job'larini o'chiradi.

questions.question: Jenkins Blue Ocean nima?
questions.explanation: Ko'p bosqichli pipeline'lar va xato nuqtalarini vizual ko'rsatadigan zamonaviy UI (hozir yangi rivojlanish yo'q).

questions.question: GitLab CI'da `cache` va `artifacts` farqi.
questions.explanation: cache — pipeline'lar orasida dependency'larni saqlab keyingi ishga tushirishni tezlashtiradi (best-effort); artifacts — bitta pipeline ichida stage'lar orasida uzatiladigan fayllar (kafolatlangan).

questions.question: GitHub Actions `hashFiles()` nima?
questions.explanation: Mos fayllar hash'ini hisoblaydi (hashFiles('/package-lock.json')) — lockfile o'zgarsa cache key ham o'zgarib, cache invalidatsiya bo'ladi.

questions.question: GitHub Actions `workflow_dispatch` nima?
questions.explanation: Workflow'ni UI yoki API orqali qo'lda, input parametrlari bilan ishga tushirish trigger'i.

questions.question: GitHub Actions `repository_dispatch` nima?
questions.explanation: Tashqi tizimlar HTTP API orqali JSON payload bilan workflow'ni ishga tushiradigan trigger.

questions.question: GitHub Actions workflow'larini qanday debug qilasiz?
questions.explanation: ACTIONS_RUNNER_DEBUG=true va ACTIONS_STEP_DEBUG=true secret/variable bilan diagnostik log yoqiladi yoki tmate bilan interaktiv SSH debug.

questions.question: Jenkins'da blue-green deployment qanday tashkil qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Plugin yoki pipeline skriptlari Blue va Green muhitlari orasida load balancer target group'ini almashtiradi yoki DNS yozuvini yangilaydi.

questions.question: GitLab CI DAG pipeline nima?
questions.explanation: needs bilan job o'z prerequisite'lari tugashi bilan stage tartibidan qat'i nazar darhol boshlanadi — pipeline tezlashadi.

questions.question: GitHub Actions concurrency group nima?
questions.explanation: Nomlangan guruh (concurrency: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}) — bir vaqtda bajarilishni cheklaydi, ortiqcha run'larni navbatga qo'yadi yoki bekor qiladi.

questions.question: GitLab CI'da avtomatik semantic release qanday qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Release stage'da semantic-release ishga tushadi: commit xabarlarini tahlil qilib Git tag, release notes yaratadi va paketni publish qiladi.

questions.question: Jenkins pipeline `post` bo'limi nima?
questions.explanation: Pipeline yoki stage tugaganda bajariladigan direktivalar (always, success, failure, unstable, cleanup) — Slack xabar, workspace tozalash.

questions.question: Jenkins agent va controller farqi.
questions.explanation: Controller — UI, pipeline parse va build'larni rejalashtirish; agent — build qadamlarini haqiqatda bajaradigan worker. Controller'da build ishlatmang (executor = 0).

questions.question: Jenkins controller'ni zararli agent'lardan qanday himoyalaysiz?
questions.explanation: Agent-to-Controller access control'ni yoqish, remoting orqali CLI'ni o'chirish, agent'larni minimal host ruxsati bilan izolyatsiyalangan ephemeral container'larda ishlatish.

questions.question: GitHub Actions `step-security/harden-runner` nima?
questions.explanation: Runner'dan chiquvchi tarmoq trafigini kuzatadi, DNS exfiltration'ni bloklaydi va CI paytida fayl buzilishini aniqlaydi.

questions.question: Composite action'da `using: "composite"` nima?
questions.explanation: action.yml dagi e'lon: action Docker container yoki JavaScript emas, composite step'lardan qurilgan.

questions.question: GitLab CI `include` nima?
questions.explanation: include:local, include:file, include:remote, include:template — tashqi YAML fayllarni import qilib pipeline'ni modullashtirish.

questions.question: GitHub Actions `runner.temp` va `runner.workspace` farqi.
questions.explanation: runner.temp — job tugagach tozalanadigan vaqtinchalik papka; runner.workspace — repo clone qilinadigan papka.

questions.question: GitLab CI'da Docker-in-Docker (dind)'ni qanday xavfsiz ishlatasiz?
questions.explanation: Rootless Docker yoki TLS yoqilgan daemon (DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR="/certs"), yoki daemon'siz build tool'lariga (Kaniko, Buildah, BuildKit rootless) o'tish. dind privileged talab qiladi — bu asosiy xavf.

questions.question: Kaniko nima va nega Kubernetes'da image build uchun afzal?
questions.explanation: Google'ning ochiq kodli tool'i: Dockerfile'dan image'ni Kubernetes pod ichida Docker daemon va privileged root'siz build qiladi. (Eslatma: loyiha 2025-yilda arxivlandi — BuildKit rootless/Buildah alternativ.)

questions.question: Buildah nima?
questions.explanation: Fon daemon yoki root ruxsatisiz OCI image build qiladigan CLI tool.

questions.question: `GITHUB_TOKEN` nima?
questions.explanation: Har workflow run uchun avtomatik yaratiladigan qisqa muddatli token; ruxsatlari permissions: bloki bilan cheklanadi, job tugashi bilan amal qilmaydi.

questions.question: GitHub Actions'da least-privilege permissions qanday qo'yiladi?
questions.explanation: Workflow boshida aniq permissions: { contents: read, id-token: write } — repo'ning ortiqcha keng default sozlamalarini bekor qiladi.

questions.question: GitHub Actions'da cron job qanday ishga tushiriladi?
questions.explanation: on: schedule: - cron: '0 2   ' — har kuni 02:00 UTC. Vaqt aniq kafolatlanmaydi (yuklamada kechikishi mumkin).

questions.question: GitLab CI o'zgaruvchilar ierarxiyasi qanday?
questions.explanation: Taxminiy ustunlik (yuqori yutadi): pipeline/trigger/manual o'zgaruvchilar > project > group > instance > YAML job'dagi > YAML global'dagi > predefined. Aniq tartibni GitLab hujjatidagi "CI/CD variable precedence" dan ...

questions.question: Jenkins Pipeline Syntax Generator nima?
questions.explanation: Ichki web tool (/pipeline-syntax): plugin va step'lar uchun to'g'ri Groovy snippet generatsiya qiladi.

questions.question: CI'da SonarQube Scanner nima?
questions.explanation: Statik tahlilni bajarib natijani SonarQube serverga yuklaydigan va Quality Gate natijasini kutadigan CLI.

questions.question: GitLab Review Apps nima?
questions.explanation: Har branch uchun avtomatik yaratiladigan ephemeral muhit, merge request sahifasi bilan bog'langan.

questions.question: GitHub Actions `continue-on-error` nima?
questions.explanation: Muhim bo'lmagan step (masalan eksperimental linter) non-zero qaytarsa ham job yiqilmasligini ta'minlovchi atribut.
